content.short: Clearing network that lets banks and fintechs redeem stablecoins and tokenized deposits at par.
content.description: Ubyx tackles what it calls the redemption gap: tokenized money moves in seconds but is hard to turn back into cash at full value. Instead of every issuer striking deals with every bank, a receiving institution connects to Ubyx once and deposits tokens for collection at par, much like cheque clearing, across any token and blockchain. Founded by former Citi payments executive Tony McLaughlin, it is backed by Galaxy Ventures, Barclays and BitGo.
content.meta: Ubyx lets banks and fintechs redeem any regulated stablecoin or tokenized deposit at par through one connection.
